description: DocSpring fills PDF and Word templates, generates PDFs from HTML templates and page designs, and collects e-signatures, through a REST API, API clients in 10 languages and an MCP server.
rules: Send API requests to https://sync.api.docspring.com/api/v2 (EU accounts: https://sync.api-eu.docspring.com/api/v2), which waits for the PDF before it answers.
Use API v2 and the 4.x API clients in new code.
Authenticate with an API token's ID and secret, as HTTP Basic auth.
Read a template's field names from GET /templates/{template_id}/schema instead of guessing them. Template IDs look like tpl_...
Make test PDFs (test: true) while developing: they're free and watermarked. Live PDFs use the account's credits.
Verify webhook requests with the X-DocSpring-Signature header and the webhook's secret before trusting them.
